hero.title: Declarative Agent Team
hero.subtitle: One config file, one AI team. Declare roles, assign skills, isolate workflows — all automated.
features.title: Modern Agent Architecture
features.subtitle: Out of the box — one config file to define your entire team.
feature.role.title: Team in One File
feature.role.desc: Define Admin, Leader, and Worker roles in a single configuration file — your team is ready to go.
feature.sandbox.title: Safe Parallel Work
feature.sandbox.desc: Each agent works in its own isolated workspace, so they never step on each other's toes.
feature.skills.title: Plug-in Skills
feature.skills.desc: Extend agent capabilities with one command. Skills are installed and ready to use instantly.

feature.dynamic.title: Smart Task Dispatch
feature.dynamic.desc: Workers are pre-spawned and ready. Leaders split tasks and dispatch automatically — no manual intervention required.
feature.merge.title: Auto Merge & Deliver
feature.merge.desc: Results are automatically merged and summarized into a final deliverable. Zero manual integration.
feature.observe.title: Live Desktop Operations
feature.observe.desc: Monitor and operate your entire agent team in real time with OAT Desktop.
hero.subtitle1: One config file, one AI team.
hero.subtitle2: Declare roles, assign skills, isolate workflows — all automated.
quickstart.title: Quick Start
quickstart.subtitle: One command, and it's yours.
flow.title: Collaboration that is auditable, reversible, and deliverable
flow.subtitle: Leaders plan, queue, and review. Workers implement and self-test in isolated branches. Only reviewed results reach the production branch.
flow.plan.title: Declare the team
flow.plan.desc: Create the project, teams, and responsibility boundaries with configuration or an Agent Resources interview.
flow.queue.title: Queue safely
flow.queue.desc: Every agent has a FIFO queue; exclusive resources and conflict keys are checked before work is created.
flow.verify.title: Implement and self-test
flow.verify.desc: Workers work on task branches and record tests, commits, and artifact paths.
flow.review.title: Leader review
flow.review.desc: Workers submit review requests; Leaders verify implementation and tests instead of taking over the task.
flow.release.title: Controlled release
flow.release.desc: Admins approve release proposals; only the serialized merge controller can update main/master.
flow.docker.title: Isolated environments per task
flow.docker.desc: Each agent session can run in a constrained Docker container while queueing and Git governance remain on the host.
flow.memory.title: Three-level collaborative memory
flow.memory.desc: L1 hot context, L2 reviewable collaboration facts, and L3 long-term evidence archives prepare retrieval and conflict prevention.
